## Required acceptance repairs

A common CalculationDefinition is insufficient. A corrected scalar source B
can be written under unchanged cards, followed by interruption before replacing
prepared densities A. The old preparation reuse check could then combine an
interior/proof from A with an inclusive rate from B. Bind prepared densities to
the EXACT scalar mathematical input in their companion. Carry the producing
source and density/tuple inventory into the aggregate interior, proof and rate;
compare them at completion, including normalization and kinematics. Retain exact
accepted inputs in the completed result companion. Mutable file paths alone
are navigation information, not sufficient acceptance evidence. No new hash
or numerical equivalence test is needed.

Also restore the explicit-contact support guard in the new RV path. The old
standard path rejected ContactTerms outside{0,1}; returning earlier in the new
path bypassed it. An interior explicit contact cannot be moved to endpoints by
two moments. For the current EEC self pairs the contact is at0 and the generated
moments1,1/2 already include it. A reusable implementation must reject additional
contact support, or account for it separately before solving endpoint moments.

The subsequent source-binding repair (beyond this reviewed revision) retains the
